job.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, New Grad – Warp Speed
job.pay_full: $135,000 – $145,000 a year (estimated base salary), plus possible restricted stock units and a sign-on bonus

details.about: Warp Speed is Palantir's push to revitalise the American industrial base. Its Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with manufacturing customers, from the factory floor to the boardroom, to understand their hardest problems and build data-driven solutions on Palantir's platforms and the latest AI.
duties: Work side by side with customers to understand their toughest problems
Collaborate with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
Wrangle massive-scale data and use AI to speed up critical operations
Build custom applications tailored to customer needs
Engage customer stakeholders from technical teams to executives
Shape team strategy and drive projects from idea to deployment in small, agile teams
needs: Strong engineering background, e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics or Data Science
Strong coding skills in Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript or similar
Able and willing to travel up to 25% to client sites
nice: A highly analytical approach to technical problems: data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks
Experience with, or curiosity about, using large-scale data on valuable business problems
Comfortable collaborating in mixed technical and non-technical teams as objectives evolve
details.benefits: Estimated salary $135,000 – $145,000 a year; total compensation may also include restricted stock units, a sign-on bonus and other incentives, depending on qualifications and experience. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, life, AD&D and disability cover, commuter benefits, relocation assistance, take-what-you-need paid time off plus two weeks off at year end, 10 paid holidays, paid leave for new parents and back-up care, fertility and family-building support, and a 401(k) plan.
